question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a supported Plugin SDK API with the proposed exact-message and wrapped-error compatibility contract?
rationale: The code can centralize current behavior, but automation cannot decide whether this internal session error identity should become a permanent external plugin contract or whether maintainers prefer a different structured error boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow predicate
options.body: Accept this focused SDK predicate after real channel proof and scope reconciliation, making its documented classification behavior a supported contract.

options.title: Expose structured error identity
options.body: Replace the message-backed predicate contract with a maintainer-designed stable code or discriminant before migrating plugin consumers.

options.title: Keep the identity internal
options.body: Do not expose this error through the Plugin SDK and close or substantially narrow the PR if duplicated plugin-side classification is preferable to a permanent API.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow predicate
recommendation.body: Accept this focused SDK predicate after real channel proof and scope reconciliation, making its documented classification behavior a supported contract.
